## What's new
- **App login.** The app opens with a login box (domain user name and password). The header now shows the user logged in to the app, with a **green dot** when that account is in **Domain Admins** (nested groups count) and a **red dot** when it isn't or nobody is logged in. **Log in** / **Log out** sit next to the name; hover the name to see the app login, the Windows user and the account the app runs as.
- **Keep me logged in.** Saves the login in Windows Credential Manager (encrypted by Windows for your account on this PC) and logs in automatically next time, checking AD again on each start. A saved password that stops working is deleted instead of being retried. Log out deletes it.
- **No more `-admin` name rule.** The header no longer looks for `-admin` at the end of the user name; the dot comes from the Domain Admins check instead.
- **c$ Share** opens the Windows logged-in user's profile on the left (found through the profile list, so folders like `d.smith.CORP` work too), instead of the app's account name with `-admin` removed.

## Upgrading from v5.3.0
- Extract the new zip over the old folder, or into a new one.
- No Config files changed, so you can keep yours as they are.
- The remote tools still run as the Windows account the app runs as, so keep starting the app as your admin account.

## Download & run
Download `HelpDeskProTools-v5.5.0-win-x64-self-contained.zip`, extract it, and run `HelpDeskProTools.exe` (ideally as your admin account).

This build is **self-contained**: .NET is included, so nothing needs to be installed on the PC. It runs as-is from a local folder or a file share.
